Definition: Shephatjah, the name of ten Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ten Israelites carry this name. First among them is Shephatiah the son of David by Abital, and the rest are the Shephatiahs of the returns from exile, the sons of Jehoshaphat, and the men of the genealogies.
TheologicalSignificance: Ten men carrying one name tells me it ran through the whole history of the kingdom. I hold that the Shephatiah who was David's son is the one I remember first, because his father is the king.
